text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing & Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café permit located at 26 Baldwin Street, Henry Street flankage.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Granted the application for the proposed boulevard café permit located at 26 Baldwin Street, Henry Street Flankage, with the following conditions: a. On the condition that a favourable petition be submitted, in advance of the permit being granted, to the satisfaction of the Ward Councillor. b. The patio will stop operations and be cleared out no later than 10:00 p.m. each night from Sunday to Thursday, and no later than 11:00 p.m. on Friday and Saturday. c. Signage will be posted in a prominent location to remind people to be considerate of the surrounding community. d. A telephone number will be provided for neighbours to register concerns or complaints directly with restaurant management. e. There will be no outdoor music or amplified sound on the patio, and doors and windows to the establishment will not be left open or propped open…
